## D — Accuracy notes and source flags: state laws of interest to drivers and golf cart rules
Every C and C2 fact cites exactly one physical manual page from the selected range; nothing relies on outside knowledge.
The manual says this section highlights only a few state laws and rules of the road, so no fact here should be read as a complete statement of SC law [A01].
The statute citations for Selective Service, organ donation, littering and golf carts are named as printed and were not checked against the SC Code itself [A02].
The golf cart rules are stated as daytime rules; the manual gives no night-time golf cart rule, so none is stated [A03].
Commercial vehicles, large non-commercial vehicles, recreational vehicles, mopeds and motorcycles are only pointed to other SCDMV manuals here, so their rules are out of scope for this section [A03].

corpus_stability.reason: The South Carolina Driver's Manual prints a single edition line (Revised 06/2024) on its front cover; its disclaimer says legislative and SCDMV policy changes may make some content out of date until the agency incorporates them, and a possibly newer unlinked upload exists on the issuer site (freshness debt in the run jams), so the corpus is treated as revised at most about once a year, bound to the registered snapshot.

verification_debt.claim_text: The manual cites SC Code §56-1-125, §44-43-320, §16-11-700 and §56-2-105 (physical pages 29 to 31); the statute text and any amendments since the Revised 06/2024 edition were not checked in this pass.
